admin.approvals_help: Applies to new drafts. One to five invited reviewers must approve the current revision. Owners cannot approve their own draft.
admin.use: Use Editorial and participate in invited drafts
admin.manage: Read every private draft, comment, archive and permanently delete drafts

forum.heading: Collaborative drafts and approvals.
forum.intro: Prepare drafts as a team, track changes and publish reviewed content as a discussion.
forum.access: Sign in with an account that has permission to use Editorial.
forum.title_placeholder: What would you like to work on?
forum.empty_help: Create a draft or ask a colleague to invite your username.
forum.leave_confirm: You have unsaved text. Leave this page and discard it?
forum.reload_confirm: Reloading discards your unsaved text and comment. Download your manuscript first if you need to keep it. Continue?
forum.confirm_publish: Publish this approved revision as a new discussion under your account?
forum.confirm_delete: Permanently delete this draft, its private comments and revision history? A published discussion will remain.
forum.confirm_restore: Restore this saved revision as a new revision? The current text remains in the history.
forum.confirm_archive: Archive this draft? It will become read-only.
forum.title: Title
forum.format_help: The toolbar uses Flarum’s editor and its active extensions. Available tools and appearance depend on your installed extensions and settings.
forum.private_help: Only participants and members with the global management permission can read these comments. They are not published.
forum.no_comments: No feedback yet. Start the conversation.
forum.approval_help: Approvals apply to the current text revision. Reopening or editing clears all approvals.
forum.privacy: Drafts stay in Editorial until the owner publishes. Forum administrators and authorised managers can read them. Downloaded copies are outside this access control.
forum.team_help: Editors can change the text. Reviewers can comment, request changes and approve. Invite existing members by their exact username. They also need the Editorial permission. Invitations appear in their workspace; no email is sent.
forum.restore_help: Restoring creates a new revision and never deletes the current history. Save your own changes first.
forum.history_limit: Showing the 100 most recent history entries.
forum.error_conflict: Someone changed this draft in the meantime. Your text has been kept here. Download it before loading the latest version, then merge your changes manually.
forum.error_not_found: This draft or revision is unavailable, or you no longer have access.
forum.error_invalid: Check your input: title 3–80 characters, text up to 63,000 characters, comments up to 5,000 characters and at most 10 categories.
forum.error_limit: A workspace limit has been reached. Archive old drafts or start a new draft.
forum.error_closed: Published and archived drafts are read-only.
forum.error_state: This action is unavailable in the current state. Check the manuscript and refresh if needed.
forum.error_member: That member could not be added. Check the username and Editorial permission. You cannot invite yourself.
forum.error_reviewers: Add enough eligible reviewers in the Team tab before requesting review. Reviewers must still have Editorial access when publishing.
forum.error_publish_failed: Flarum could not publish this discussion. Check forum and category permissions and required fields.
forum.error_request: The request failed. Check your permissions and connection. When publishing, also check Flarum category rules and log entries.
forum.error_unsaved: Save or download your text before performing another action.
forum.action_invite: Team member added or role changed
forum.recovered: Unsaved text from your previous visit to this draft has been restored in this tab. Save it before closing or reloading the browser.
forum.search_help: Type at least three characters for member suggestions. You can also enter the exact username directly.
forum.search_failed: Search is unavailable. Enter the exact username directly.
